prose.subject: Invoice INV-70695 - Fennick Facilities
prose.body:
Dear Accounts Payable Team at Fallowfield Games,

Please find attached the normal monthly invoice INV-70695 from Fennick Facilities for services rendered during the current billing cycle.

The total amount due is 1133.16 USDC. This invoice covers the following line items:

1. Routine Facility Maintenance: 450.00 USDC
2. HVAC System Inspection: 300.16 USDC
3. Electrical Panel Upgrades: 383.00 USDC

As per our standard agreement, payment is due within 30 days of the invoice date. We kindly request that you transfer the funds to our usual vendor account: 0x33bac2d2b3f95e69bd1a6bd37a6c4e33215f59cf.

Please verify that the invoice number and amount match your records. If you have any questions regarding the services provided or the payment details, do not hesitate to contact our billing department at billing@fennick-facilities.example.

Thank you for your continued partnership.

Sincerely,

Fennick Facilities Billing Department
